flag_fiber.locality_invariance: verified by equality of every low-address prefix subspace

frontier.definition: exact locality frontier over (Q_fine, J_peak, J_area); J_place is not a dominance coordinate

layout_scope: one shared full standard cut-point word across all target matrices

locality_frontier.definition: exact Pareto frontier over (Q_fine, J_peak, J_area)

oracle.definition: minimum median kernel time over every shared-word G_S canonical flag representative; fiber materializations are excluded

oracle_feature_audit.definition: componentwise minimization over Q_fine, every nonzero locality excess footprint, raw and normalized placement, within-array and cross-array placement, and every global allocation phase

placement_reranker.definition: retain the three-cost locality frontier, add the lowest corrected-J_place member of each coordinatewise locality shell bucket, then rank the bounded union by the selected global-phase J_place statistic

selection_mechanisms.definition: minimum J_area; ties break by fewer codegen runs then canonical word
selection_mechanisms.name: lowest_hardware_area

selection_mechanisms.definition: five lowest J_area layouts; ties break by fewer codegen runs then canonical word
selection_mechanisms.name: top5_hardware_area

selection_mechanisms.definition: top corrected-J_place recommendations from the bounded locality shell, capped at 1 layouts
selection_mechanisms.name: placement_rerank_at_1

selection_mechanisms.definition: top corrected-J_place recommendations from the bounded locality shell, capped at 3 layouts
selection_mechanisms.name: placement_rerank_at_3

selection_mechanisms.definition: top corrected-J_place recommendations from the bounded locality shell, capped at 5 layouts
selection_mechanisms.name: placement_rerank_at_5

selection_mechanisms.definition: top corrected-J_place recommendations from the bounded locality shell, capped at 10 layouts
selection_mechanisms.name: placement_rerank_at_10
